card.title: Guess your Santa
card.open: Who do you think is buying your gift? Guess the rest of the draw too, if you like. You can change your guesses until those Santas are shown on gift day.
card.when: You'll find out at your turn on gift day.

dialog.title: Who's your Santa?
dialog.description: A point for every pair you get right. Nobody sees your guesses until those Santas are shown on gift day.
dialog.saved: Guesses saved. You'll find out at your turn on gift day.

present.on-phones: Guess on your phones: who's it from?

live.ask: Who do you think it's from?
live.hint: Tap a name. You can change it until the Santa is shown.

settings.description: Everyone can guess who their Santa is and the rest of the draw, for points, and change their guesses until those Santas are shown. On gift day everyone can guess on their phone who each gift is from, then the presenter view shows the Santa, with everyone's guesses and the leaderboard. Switch it off to keep Santas secret.
settings.off: Guess your Santa is off: Santas stay secret

panel.note: Each person's Santa is shown at their turn. Switch off Guess your Santa to keep Santas secret.

errors.NOT_FOUND: That person isn't in this draw.
errors.EDITION_CHANGED: Someone changed this edition just now. Reload the page and try again.
